html:
Let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the Top 10 hottest check-in spots in Hanoi, which will help you have the most enjoyable tour when you have the opportunity to set foot in Hanoi.

The best time to travel to Hanoi is December – March and July to September. The climate here has 4 distinct seasons. Visitors will admire the scenery of Hanoi and experience the cultural space of the North.

1. Long Bien Bridge

The bridge is the pride of the people of the capital. The bridge crosses the Red River. From the bridge, visitors can admire the scenery of the poetic river and in the distance is the scenery of the peaceful countryside. Visitors can capture beautiful pictures.

2. Train Street

As one of the ancient places of the capital, many young people come to take virtual photos, especially when the train is running, surrounded by ancient houses exuding a simple beauty in the old town.

3. Cathedral

The church has its own design, located at the intersection of 3 major streets, this place is most beautifully decorated on Christmas, visitors will be immersed in the atmosphere of the festival night.

4. Cat Linh Station

An extremely hot check-in spot chosen by many young people, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visitors should visit here and take pictures of themselves at Ha Dong station with very impressive background photos for you to save beautiful pictures.

5. Sunflower Field

The flower field is located near Nhat Tan Bridge, a virtual living spot for every tourist when they have the opportunity to set foot in Hanoi, the flower field located next to the peaceful river is a relaxing spot chosen by many tourists, especially on weekends or during their vacations.

6. Phung Hung Mural Street

A place with its own unique beauty, coming here, visitors seem to relive the ancient space that looks like fairy gardens, all recreated by Vietnamese – Korean artists, bringing a colorful space.

7. Van Phuc Village

A traditional silk village, visitors can visit the stalls to buy souvenirs or take beautiful pictures of the craft village scene, the peaceful countryside here still retains the traditional beauty of the Vietnamese countryside.

8. Ho Guom Walking Street

A peaceful space without dust, because this place is reserved for pedestrians, especially on weekends, visitors come here not only to visit, check in or admire the scenery but also to blend in with the vibrant atmosphere of melodious music…

9. Long Bien Flower Grassland

Located in the suburbs of Hanoi, where there are many colorful flowers, it is a check-in spot that many tourists come to, visit and admire the colorful flowers.

10. Vinpearl Aquarium

Located in the center of Hanoi, Vinpearl Aquarium is home to many rare marine species, appearing in the cool blue water, a beautiful scene, a virtual living spot that many young people are hunting for.

If you are a virtual life lover, follow Vietlook Travel to visit and admire the scenery at the famous landmarks of Hanoi Capital today. You do not need to spend too much time, just register for a 1-day Hanoi tour and you can be satisfied with the beauty of the capital.

In addition, when arriving in Hanoi, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes such as: Pho, Bun thang, Bun oc chuoi dau, Bun rieu, Bun moc, Bun dau mam tom, Chao ca, nem, beef salad… or snacks that you must try at least once in your life such as Trang Tien ice cream, Pho Co cafe, My van thang… bringing the delicious flavor of Northern cuisine.

Hanoi not only has a long-standing historical culture but also owns beautiful landscapes. Any visitor who first sets foot in Hanoi will be amazed by the natural beauty and many beautiful virtual living spots
